faq.a: Jared Gibbons is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation (PREC) with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty. He works mainly in South Surrey, White Rock and Langley and across the wider Fraser Valley, and has worked in the Fraser Valley market for over a decade.
Suite 201 - 15272 Croydon Dr, Surrey, BC, with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty.
Call or text 604-928-1361 (the same number works on WhatsApp), email jaredgibbons@royallepage.ca, or use the contact form on this site.
South Surrey, White Rock and Langley are his home market, and he also works across the rest of the Fraser Valley, including Surrey, Abbotsford, Mission and Chilliwack, and into Metro Vancouver.

faq.q: Does Jared offer property management or appraisals?
faq.a: No. Jared helps people buy and sell homes. He does not offer property management or appraisal services.

faq.q: What Royal LePage awards has Jared Gibbons received?
faq.a: Jared’s Royal LePage awards include the Red Diamond Award (2021, 2023), the Diamond Award (2016 to 2020), Award of Excellence as a Lifetime Member and Repeat Member (2025), the Top Ten Award for British Columbia (2024, 2025), Top 35 Under 35 as an individual (2020, 2024, 2025) and with his team (2023), Executive Circle (2022, 2024, 2025), and the National Top 2% (2022, 2024, 2025) and Top 5% (2022 to 2025) awards. The full list is on this page.
